# Cluster Recorder API

<!-- GENERATED by `make docs` from internal/api/openapi.yaml. Do not edit. -->

Read-only forensic API over retained Kubernetes events, pod transitions, node snapshots and change records. Unauthenticated; ClusterIP-only in v1. Time parameters accept RFC3339, Unix seconds, or a negative duration relative to now such as -10m or -6h. Defaults: from=-1h, to=now.

## `GET /api/v1/agent/hints`

CNI detection hints for a node agent (DaemonSets cluster-wide, the node's pod CIDRs and the cluster CIDR). Agents have no API access; this is how they learn cluster facts.

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | query | string | required. |

- `200`: {daemonsets[], pod_cidrs[]}

## `POST /api/v1/agent/snapshots`

Node agent sample ingest (tier 2). Source is forced to agent.

- `202`: {id, changes}
- `400`: invalid snapshot

## `GET /api/v1/events`

Retained events, past the API server TTL

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `namespace` | query | string |  |
| `node` | query | string |  |
| `from` | query | string |  |
| `to` | query | string |  |
| `limit` | query | integer | default `1000` |

- `200`: list of Event

## `GET /api/v1/healthz`

Liveness

- `200`: ok

## `GET /api/v1/incidents`

Detected clusters of failure, each with every change record from the preceding 6 hours

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | query | string | default `-720h` |
| `to` | query | string |  |
| `open` | query | boolean | only unclosed incidents |

- `200`: list of Incident

## `GET /api/v1/nodes`

Nodes with recorded snapshots, last snapshot times, detected driver

- `200`: list of NodeSummary

## `GET /api/v1/nodes/{node}/diff`

Latest snapshot versus last healthy baseline, field by field, per source

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | path | string | required. |
| `against` | query | string | default `baseline` |

- `200`: {node, sources: {api|agent: {baseline_time, current_time, fields[], note}}}
- `404`: node has no snapshots

## `GET /api/v1/nodes/{node}/snapshots`

Raw snapshots for one node, all sources

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | path | string | required. |
| `from` | query | string |  |
| `to` | query | string |  |

- `200`: list of Snapshot

## `GET /api/v1/nodes/{node}/timeline`

Merged, time-ordered change records, events and pod transitions for one node. The primary endpoint.

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | path | string | required. |
| `from` | query | string |  |
| `to` | query | string |  |

- `200`: list of TimelineEntry

## `GET /api/v1/readyz`

Readiness (informer caches synced)

- `200`: ready
- `503`: still syncing
